# Tutorial 04: GitOps With Argo CD

## Goal

Understand how ClusterForge platform modules can bootstrap Argo CD for GitOps.

## Prerequisites

- existing disposable Kubernetes cluster
- `terraform` or `tofu`
- `kubectl`

## Commands

```bash
cd examples/kubernetes-argocd-bootstrap
terraform init
terraform plan -out argocd.tfplan
terraform apply argocd.tfplan
```

## Generated Files

No files are generated by this tutorial.

## What Terraform Creates

- Argo CD namespace and Helm release, depending on example configuration

## Validate

```bash
kubectl get pods -n argocd
kubectl get services -n argocd
```

## Cleanup

```bash
terraform destroy
```

## Troubleshooting

Check Helm provider connectivity, chart version availability, namespace
ownership, and Kubernetes RBAC.
